video_title: The Inside Guys react to Cavs-Knicks ECF Game 2 blowout 🔥 | Inside The NBA

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley criticizes Cavaliers for not feeding Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen
quotes.excerpt: Why the hell you score 14 points and don't get a shot in the second half?
quotes.quote: Why the hell you score 14 points and don't get a shot in the second half? That's my point, fool. Some of it's ball to... That's ball to... Stop Evan Mobley, yo! He's out here housing people. And you all want to shoot these long ass jump shots, but that's the NBA today, no strategy. You know, we tell them why you should never score on an out of bounds play, Kenny, because you got five seconds to score.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley criticizes analytics as a way for rich owners to hire family
quotes.excerpt: All these rich dudes want to give their son-in-law a job. That's how they came with analytics.
quotes.quote: That's minus 23. While you're on the floor? Yeah. Yeah, but the only person, the only other person who played great that game was Josh, was Jalen Brunson, who went crazy. That's not his minus 23. Stop it. It's what it's what it was. Yeah, because you want to give your son-in-law a job. That's how you all brought analytics into play. All these rich dudes want to give their son-in-law a job. That's how they came with analytics. It's because he married your damn daughter, you don't mean you have to give him a job.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley praises Jalen Brunson for adjusting to defense by setting career-high assists
quotes.excerpt: I ain't going to keep just jacking it up, throwing it around, I'm going to take the pass.
quotes.quote: You know the difference between good players, great players, good coaches and bad coaches, making adjustments. Richard Jefferson and Tim Legler were doing a great job. They're like, we're going to stop Brunson. Brunson's like, okay, I'm going to set a career high in assists. I ain't going to keep just jacking it up, throwing it around. I'm going to take the pass. He set a career high.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley questions Cavaliers' failure to utilize their bigs' size advantage
quotes.excerpt: The guys who have a size advantage, James and Mitchell don't have an advantage.
quotes.quote: I said the only way the Cavs can win this series is if they dominate inside. They were dominating inside. They were only down four at the half. Mobley had he was five for eight, 14 points. Allen was having a good game. Mobley did not take a shot in the second half. They only gave it to Allen three times in the second half, the guys who have a size advantage. James and Mitchell don't have an advantage. Those two guys have an advantage. I don't understand this guy's got 14 points, having a great game, and you don't even get a shot.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges describes Josh Hart's mental toughness and resilience after a tough game
quotes.excerpt: He's going to keep staying in the gym and keep taking the open shots.
quotes.quote: Yeah, J. Hart just mental toughness, that's the biggest thing. And he embodies that. He's going to keep staying in the gym and keep taking the open shots. I know he's frustrated, but he's mentally tough, he's going to forget about it and be ready to knock down the next shot.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges explains how the Knicks stay grounded amidst New York's excitement
quotes.excerpt: We got a lot of resilient in the locker room, a lot of guys that just understand the main goal.
quotes.quote: I think we got a lot of resilient in the locker room, a lot of guys that just understand the main goal and that's pretty much it. I know the New York's having fun and all that, but you know, we're not out there, we, you know, in the gym, you know, staying locked in. So, you know, they can have all the fun they want, we're just going to stay locked in. Our fun is on the court, so go keep going at it and just stay with it.

quotes.speaker: Mikal Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges compares his, Josh Hart's, and Jalen Brunson's evolving roles from college to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: My offensive game wasn't there as much, and so when he left I grew, had an opportunity.
quotes.quote: Yeah, I think so Josh, senior year, Jalen always, I mean Jalen was scoring when he was a freshman, so he was scoring the whole time. There was no in between, he was scoring his all three years there. But Josh was, you know, shooting a lot of shots, him and him and J.B. were scoring a lot. And I don't think I really shot the ball that much, kind of just, you know, defending, doing my thing. And then Josh left, graduated, came to the league. And then me and Jalen had our last year. And I was, you know, scoring a little bit more, being in offense, but still defending as well. But I think when I was in college with Josh, my offensive game wasn't, you know, there as much. And so when he left, I grew, you know, I had an opportunity. So it was kind of different when Josh was there, but we all just had a lot of games together, a lot of practice days. You know, we feed off each other, know how to play the right way. And it's great that we're together right now.

quotes.speaker: Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.summary_phrase: Shaquille O'Neal stresses the Cavaliers' urgent need to win Game 3 to stay in the series
quotes.excerpt: What if the shots don't go down in Game 3, what adjustments are you going to make?
quotes.quote: I mean, that's what we all say. And he's absolutely correct, they shot 38%. They're not playing well. So, and they do have the experience of, you know, being down 0-2. However, you got to win Game 3. What if the shots don't go down in Game 3? What adjustments are you going to make to slow the Knicks down? You know, Kenny said it earlier, they're not going to let Brunson get off, make somebody else beat us. Now, when he gets hot, you still have to make, you know, adjustments. Josh had 26, Mikal had 19, and Anunoby had 14. So, you know, they're playing well, they're hot, they're very high on themselves. The Knicks smell it, and the Cleveland Cavs have to win this Game 3, or else.

quotes.speaker: Mike Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown details the Knicks' defensive and offensive adjustments and individual player contributions
quotes.excerpt: We did a better job spraying the basketball and taking care of the ball.
quotes.quote: Our defense overall, besides those two things, first half, giving up offensive rebounds, second half, sending them to the free throw line, it was pretty good, especially when you have the talent that they have and all the All-Stars that they have, the great players and the shooting that they have. For us, offensively, we have to keep playing faster. We did a better job spraying the basketball and taking care of the ball. We had 15 sprays this game compared to nine sprays in Game 1. When we hit that paint, we have to play off of two because they do a good job of protecting the paint. Got to get that ball off the glass, play faster. We did a better job playing faster this game. The seven turnovers was pretty good for a game against a team in the playoffs. A lot of guys stepped up. Jalen had a double-double with 14 assists. Cat with a double-double, 18 points and 13 rebounds. Mikal was huge with 19 points. OG was awesome too, he guarded Allen most of the game. Josh had seven assists, one turnover and 33 plus minutes, leading scorer with 26 points. If they continue to leave him open, he's got to continue to let it fly.
